why: Take 2 opened with the most life, mistaking him for a Bureau man. Kept the last version; only the flagged closing line changed.
changes: Final Fixer line: replaced "Get some sleep" with "Mind your tables", because the return can come during this shift, on the same mission clock.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If you're from the Bureau, you're early. I'm still on shift.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I'm not. I've just paid them part of your loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who saw you? I don't know you. Who's been asking about me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nobody saw. People say you're the kind one on the terrace.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Kind? The Bureau's my worst customer. Stays all day, never tips.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Part of him's gone home, then. We'll want one small thing.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What thing? Don't tell me. I took it, but not yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not yet, then. Mind your tables. I'll bring the rest.

learned: She took it; not ready yet.
